svg.title: /ask 怎麼回答領班的問題
svg.desc: Data-flow: a supervisor's question becomes a typed plan of tool calls from one LLM call; the plan is validated against real tool signatures and the store's value domains and refused with every error if it fails; valid calls fan out in parallel, results are collected with a chart derived from their shape, a second LLM call writes prose beside the figures, and the run is stored so a chart is redrawn from data rather than by re-planning.

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', monospace
